result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: the second card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is vertically misaligned, the first card image appears washed out, and the favorite heart buttons are styled inconsistently.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card sits about 28px lower than its neighbors. Its image, time badge, title and delivery fee all start lower than those on the 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccola' cards, producing a jagged row.
issues.suggestion: Remove the extra top margin or offset on the second carousel item, or align items to the top (e.g., align-items: flex-start), so all cards share the same top edge.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' card image looks faded and low-contrast compared with the other carousel images. It resembles a translucent or overlay state, as if it were stuck in a loading or disabled look.
issues.suggestion: Check for a leftover opacity or placeholder overlay on the first carousel image and render it at full opacity, consistent with the other cards.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently. On the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card, the heart has no background, while on the pizza card below it sits in a dark circular container.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same button style (e.g., a semi-transparent dark circle behind the heart) to every card for consistency and reliable contrast over varied images.
